# A collapsed board column hides its title at 0px height

## Context

Surfaced during Step 1 ("Drive it first") of #21632 (`examples/board/columns` under #21346 / #21140). Setting `collapsed: true` on any `Neo.board.Column` renders the 44px folded strip with its count badge and expand toggle, while the column's vertical title (`span.neo-board-column-title`) collapses to **`0px` height** (`getBoundingClientRect().height === 0`, `top === bottom === 91`) and disappears completely.

## The Problem

Reproducer against `examples/board/basic` at `1440 × 900`:
1. Set `collapsed: true` on the `Review` column (`board.columns = [..., {status: 'review', title: 'Review', collapsed: true}, ...]`).
2. Inspect `.neo-board-column-collapsed .neo-board-column-title`: `textContent` is `"Review"`, `width` is `17px`, and **`height` is `0px`**.

Every collapsed column in `Neo.board.Container` therefore renders an unlabeled strip, blocking #21632 AC-1 (*"The first frame shows one folded column with its title and count"*).

## The Architectural Reality

- Design authority: `src/board/Column.mjs:10-11` (`@description`: *"a collapsed column keeps its header and count and hides its body"*) and `resources/css/src/board/Column.css:27-30`, which explicitly declares vertical typography (`writing-mode: vertical-rl; text-orientation: mixed;`) for `.neo-board-column-collapsed .neo-board-column-title`.
- Root cause in `resources/css/src/board/Column.css`:
  - `.neo-board-column-header` (`lines 34-43`) sets `display: flex; flex: none;` (indefinite `auto` height inside the column's `vbox` flex layout).
  - `.neo-board-column-header .neo-board-column-title` (`lines 56-62`) sets `flex: 1;` (`1 1 0%`) and `overflow: hidden;` for horizontal row layout.
  - `.neo-board-column-collapsed` (`lines 18-31`) switches `.neo-board-column-header` to `flex-direction: column` without resetting `flex` on `.neo-board-column-title`. Inside an indefinite-height column flex container, `flex-basis: 0%` combined with `overflow: hidden` resolves the item's main-axis height to `0px`.

## The Fix

1. In `resources/css/src/board/Column.css` under `&.neo-board-column-collapsed`:
   - Give `.neo-board-column-header` `box-sizing: border-box; max-height: 100%;` so long titles remain bounded by the column's height.
   - Set `flex: 0 1 auto; min-height: 0;` on `.neo-board-column-title` so its vertical main-axis basis uses its natural `vertical-rl` text length while still shrinking/ellipsizing if constrained by column height.
2. Rebuild `dist/` CSS themes (`node ./buildScripts/build/themes.mjs -f -n -e dev -t all`) if bundled theme outputs change (note: `resources/css/src/` is loaded directly in dev and bundled in dist).
3. Add a rendered geometry regression test in `test/playwright/e2e/board/` (or existing board E2E spec) asserting `.neo-board-column-collapsed .neo-board-column-title` has `boundingBox().height > 20` and non-zero `width` across collapsed and re-collapsed states.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A `Neo.board.Column` configured with `collapsed: true` (and one toggled via `.neo-board-column-collapse`) renders `.neo-board-column-title` vertically with `getBoundingClientRect().height > 20` and readable non-clipped text in all shipped themes.
- [ ] Uncollapsed column headers preserve `flex: 1` single-line `text-overflow: ellipsis` truncation.
- [ ] A Playwright browser test fails on `dev` (`height === 0`) and passes at PR head.

## Out of Scope

- Example application authoring (`examples/board/columns` stays in #21632).
- `Neo.board.LaneRow` collapsed headers (already horizontal and verified separately in #21394).

## Avoided Traps

- **Using `flex: none` (`0 0 auto`) without `max-height: 100%` on the header:** an unusually long column title would overflow the bottom border of a short board; `flex: 0 1 auto; min-height: 0;` with `max-height: 100%` keeps natural vertical sizing and still truncates cleanly when taller than the column.
